name: URL Codec
description: Percent-encode, decode, and inspect the structure of URLs.

results.outputHint: The result can be copied directly.

hints.input: Encoding turns non-ASCII characters into percent-escapes; decoding restores them.
hints.plusAsSpace: Form submissions often write spaces as `+`. Enable this to restore them while decoding.
hints.output: "Parse structure" additionally lists the scheme, host, port, path, and query parameters.

faq.q: How is encoding different from escaping?
faq.a: URL encoding only handles percent-escaping; it is not HTML escaping. Use a separate HTML escape when you need XSS protection.

faq.q: Why did `+` not become a space?
faq.a: Turn off "Treat + as space". A `+` in a path is a literal plus sign, not a space.

faq.q: Why is the port empty in the parsed result?
faq.a: The URL does not spell out a port, so it uses the default one (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS). The tool does not fill it in.
